basis: [Shoot-borne (adventitious) root primordia / transition cells] Class IB LBD TF required for shoot-borne root initiation (Omary et al. 2022 Science)
validation: pSBRL:mScarlet-NLS in phloem-associated transition cells; sbrl CRISPR mutants lack shoot-borne roots (Omary 2022)

basis: [Lateral root primordium (and overlying endodermis/cortex)] LBD superlocus redundantly required for LR initiation (Omary et al. 2022 Science)
validation: pSBRL reporter in early LR initiation and overlying cells; sbrl bsbrl double mutant reduces LR primordia (Omary 2022 Fig. 4)

basis: Sucrose transporter essential for phloem loading, protein and mRNA in enucleate SE (Kuhn et al. 1997 Science)
validation: immunolocalization in SE plasma membrane and in situ mRNA mainly in SE (tobacco, potato, tomato; Kuhn 1997)

basis: Linalool synthase that makes monoterpenes in glandular trichomes (van Schie et al. 2007 Plant Mol Biol; Spyropoulou et al. 2014 Plant Mol Biol)
validation: promoter-reporter: the minimal TPS5 promoter is enough for glandular-trichome-specific expression in transgenic tomato; transcripts mostly in trichomes

basis: EXPRESSION OF TERPENOIDS 1, a SHI/STY-family TF specific to glandular trichomes (Spyropoulou et al. 2014 Plant Mol Biol)
validation: glandular-trichome-specific expression; transactivates the TPS5 promoter

basis: bHLH TF required for type VI glandular trichome formation and terpene biosynthesis (Xu et al. 2018 Plant Cell)
validation: knockdown gives smaller and fewer type VI glands, knockout abolishes them; regulates terpene synthases in gland cells

basis: Neryl diphosphate synthase that supplies the monoterpene precursor in type VI glandular trichomes (Schilmiller et al. 2009 PNAS)
validation: 333-fold higher in isolated stem trichomes than in trichome-free stems (Fig. 2); abundant in a trichome cDNA library

basis: Woolly HD-ZIP IV TF controlling multicellular trichome initiation and fate (Yang et al. 2011 PNAS; Wu et al. 2023 Dev Cell)
validation: gain-of-function alleles and RNAi alter type I/digitate trichome formation; Wo dosage specifies multicellular trichome types

basis: Hair C2H2 zinc-finger protein that interacts with Woolly to initiate multicellular trichomes (Chang et al. 2018 Plant J)
validation: map-based cloning; deletion causes loss of type I trichomes; ectopic expression induces trichomes in tobacco
